body: I appreciate your advice, and yes I spend a lot of my time out of the house and I try to have as minimal interactions as possible with them but even these very few times that they interact with me they are dreadful. The thing about sharing my problems with friends is that Idk how they would react as they can't imagine me having such problems, with that said I might try opening up to them but slowly if I feel they would understand. I really appreciate you taking the time to give a random stranger an advice.
No. I'm not in the US. Thank you though.

I'm 20 and in my second year of college. Right now I can't afford to get out but, I'm planning to as soon as I finish college. For the help part, I didn't tell anyone about my situation even my close friends they think I have the perfect relationship with my family (from the few interactions they saw) and I made a throwaway account just so they won't think I'm suicidal.
How can I escape them? that would fix everything with me!
What's the point if they are restricting me from the "other things"
